§6Schrabidium§f

§aThe most iconic material in the mod. Radioactive, blinding, and required for basically everything endgame.§f

§bSchrabidium§f (Sa-326, atomic 126) is a transuranic superactinide at §e15 RAD/s§f per ingot. Hold it without tier 3 hazmat and you go blind. Density is §e39,700 kg/m³§f, roughly twice tungsten. It is magnetic enough to boost tungsten into Magnetized Tungsten.

§6Production Methods§f:
§b•§f Explode nuclear waste barrels near uranium ore (crude, unreliable)
§b•§f §bPUREX§f, process depleted LEP ZIRNOX/MEP PWR fuel with §e500 mB Schrabidic Acid§f, yields §e0.75 ingots§f
§b•§f §bExposure Chamber§f, Higgs Boson transmutes U-238 at §e100%§f efficiency, best bulk method
§b•§f §bCyclotron§f, nuggets from ionized particles, tiny amounts

§6What It Is For§f:
§b•§f Magnetized Tungsten (1 tungsten + 1 schrabidium nugget)
§b•§f SNB reactor fuel (HES/MES/LES)
§b•§f Pure schrabidium Watz fuel pellets
§b•§f Nuclear weapons, custom nuke schrabidium stage
§b•§f Solinium, euphemium, and all trans-schrabidic elements

§ePS:§f Set up PUREX with schrabidic acid for early supply. Build the Exposure Chamber with Higgs Bosons for bulk. Wear hazmat or enjoy the blindness.
